---
brand:
  light: _brand.yml
params:
  nacho_rds: ""
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    fig.retina: 1
format:
  html:
    lang: en-US
    format-links: false
    embed-resources: true
    template-partials:
      - partials/title-block.html
    title-block-banner: true
    theme:
      light: [brand, nacho-report.scss]
    filters:
      - path: accessible-tables.lua
        at: post-quarto
      - path: caption-prefix.lua
        at: post-render
    language:
      skip-to-content: "Skip to the report"
    toc: true
    toc-title: Contents
    toc-location: right
    toc-depth: 2
    number-sections: true
    fig-width: 7
    fig-height: 4.5
    fig-dpi: 96
  typst:
    lang: en-US
    papersize: a4
    pdf-standard: ua-1
    font-paths: fonts
    fig-format: png
    fig-dpi: 300
    filters:
      - nacho-styles.lua
    template-partials:
      - partials/typst-template.typ
      - partials/typst-show.typ
    toc: true
    toc-title: Contents
    toc-depth: 1
    section-numbering: "1.1"
crossref:
  title-delim: "."
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
report <- NACHO:::report_setup(params$nacho_rds)
x <- report$object
```

# Decision summary

```{r}
#| label: decisions
#| output: asis
cat(NACHO:::report_decisions(x), sep = "\n")
```

# Settings and thresholds

```{r}
#| label: parameters
#| output: asis
cat(NACHO:::report_parameters(x), sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: body
#| output: asis
NACHO:::report_body(report)
```

```{r}
#| label: methods
#| output: asis
cat(NACHO:::report_methods(x), sep = "\n")
```
